[[File:MolecularDisruptor-TFC.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Mungo Baobab]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] study a molecular disruptor.]]
'''Molecular disruptors''' were large devices that resembled mirrors and had the ability to shrink objects that came into contact with them. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon's]] [[Tawntoom]] province used the devices as traps for intruders at the [[Fortress of Tawntoom]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was shrunk by one such device in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], though the effect was only temporary.
